_comment: Human decisions for taxonomy_v1 (B). Assistant recommendations, confirmed by B on 2026-11-12 (incl. merging tree_ornaments). Edit, then run v1_step3_build.py. accept=false keeps the v0 subcategory unchanged. merge: {source: target}, applied after all proposals; the target's definition is redrafted. Keys starting with _ are ignored. Round 2 (2026-11-12, confirmed by B): definition fixes, seed_overrides, Charlotte bag stays in fashion_handbags.

merge._why: 92 subcategories after splits is above the 60-80 target; merge tiny or overlapping ones -> 76. pet_items is no longer merged: misplaced pet bowls moved into it (14 codes, 279 Discovery baskets).

hanging_ornaments.name_zh: 悬挂装饰（含圣诞树挂饰）
hanging_ornaments.definition: Ornaments designed to be hung from a tree, branch, hook, window or wall, for any season: tree decorations, baubles, hanging hearts, stars and birds, and mobiles.
hanging_ornaments.boundary: Includes tree decorations, baubles, hanging hearts, stars and birds, and mobiles; excludes garlands and bunting (bunting_garland), wreaths (wreaths), freestanding figures (tabletop_decorations) and hanging candle holders (candle_holder_lantern). Season is recorded separately and does not change the subcategory.

incense.definition: Incense sticks and cones and other non-candle home-fragrance items: incense holders, oil burners, fragrance oils and scented sachets.
incense.boundary: Includes incense, incense holders, oil burners, fragrance oils and sachets, and incense-and-candle sets; excludes candles (the four candle subcategories) and candle holders (candle_holder_lantern).

storage_baskets_decor.name_zh: 装饰收纳篮与玩具收纳
storage_baskets_decor.definition: Woven, wicker, wooden or fabric baskets, chests and tidies for storage or display, including toy tidies and picnic baskets.
storage_baskets_decor.boundary: Includes storage and picnic baskets, nesting basket sets, wooden chests and toy tidies; excludes laundry and peg bags (household_laundry_storage), food tins and jars (kitchen_storage) and small trinket boxes (trinket_jewellery_box).

keyrings_tags.definition: Small attachable accessories: keyrings and key fobs, bag and phone charms, and luggage tags.
keyrings_tags.boundary: Includes keyrings, key fobs, bag charms, phone charms and luggage tags; excludes jewellery worn on the body (jewellery) and gift tags (gift_wrap_tags).

furniture_knobs.definition: Small furniture such as cabinets, drawer units and side, occasional or coffee tables, plus furniture hardware such as drawer knobs and handles.
furniture_knobs.boundary: Includes cabinets, drawer units, small tables, drawer knobs and pulls; excludes wall shelves and hooks (hooks_racks_shelves), storage baskets (storage_baskets_decor), table linens (kitchen_textiles) and TV tray tables (serving_trays_platters).

cushions_textiles.definition: Cushions, cushion covers and other soft-furnishing textiles such as throws.
cushions_textiles.boundary: Includes filled cushions and cushion covers; excludes kitchen and table textiles (kitchen_textiles), bath towels (bath_beauty), hot water bottles (hot_water_bottle) and doorstops (doorstops_paperweights).

greeting_cards.definition: Greeting cards, postcards, notelets and envelopes for occasions and messages.
greeting_cards.boundary: Includes single cards, card packs, postcards, notelets and envelopes; excludes gift tags (gift_wrap_tags), card games such as snap cards (games_puzzles) and card holders (tabletop_decorations).

kitchen_textiles.definition: Fabric items for the kitchen and dining table: tea towels, aprons, oven gloves, tablecloths and table runners.
kitchen_textiles.boundary: Includes tea towels, aprons, oven gloves, tablecloths, table runners and fabric napkins; excludes paper napkins (party_tableware), bath towels (bath_beauty) and cushions (cushions_textiles).

umbrella_rainwear.definition: Umbrellas, parasols and rainwear such as ponchos and rain hats.
umbrella_rainwear.boundary: Includes folding umbrellas, decorative parasols, ponchos and rain hats; excludes other clothing (clothing_slippers) and paper cocktail parasols (party_tableware).

chalkboards_memo_boards.boundary: Use for plain writing surfaces (blackboards, chalkboards, memo boards); boards whose main function is storage with hooks or pockets go to hooks_racks_shelves; worded decorative signs go to wall_signs.

teapot_tea_set.definition: Teapots, coffee pots, tea sets and matching tea-time serving pieces such as milk jugs, sugar bowls and tea, coffee or sugar caddies.
teapot_tea_set.boundary: Includes teapots, coffee pots, multi-piece tea sets, milk jugs, sugar bowls and tea caddies; excludes single mugs and cup-and-saucer items (mugs_cups) and general food storage tins (kitchen_storage).

clothing_slippers.definition: Wearable clothing and footwear (slippers, socks, scarves, hats, dresses, baby bibs) and hand-held fans.
clothing_slippers.boundary: Includes slippers, socks, scarves, sun hats, children's clothing, bibs and fans; excludes knitting kits (sewing_craft), sock puppets (soft_toys), rainwear (umbrella_rainwear) and hand warmers (hand_warmer).

vases_planters.definition: Vases, posy holders, plant pots and planters for cut flowers or plants, including wall and hanging planters.
vases_planters.boundary: Includes vases, posy holders, indoor plant pots and planters; excludes small trinket pots (trinket_jewellery_box), garden ornaments and tools (garden_outdoor) and candle holders (candle_holder_lantern).

trinket_jewellery_box.definition: Decorative small boxes, pots and trays for jewellery and small items: jewellery boxes, trinket pots and trays, jewellery stands, sewing boxes and tissue box covers.
trinket_jewellery_box.boundary: Includes jewellery boxes, trinket pots and trays, jewellery stands, sewing boxes and tissue boxes; excludes gift boxes (gift_boxes), food storage tins and jars (kitchen_storage) and storage baskets (storage_baskets_decor).

purse_wallet.definition: Purses, wallets, coin purses and card or passport holders for carrying money and documents.
purse_wallet.boundary: Includes purses, wallets and passport covers; excludes toiletry and cosmetic bags (wash_cosmetic_bags), handbags (fashion_handbags) and keyrings (keyrings_tags).

wash_cosmetic_bags.boundary: Includes washbags, cosmetic and make-up bags and toiletry pouches; excludes purses and wallets (purse_wallet) and drawstring or laundry bags (household_laundry_storage).

decorative_candles.definition: Candles made or decorated for display rather than standard lighting: figural and novelty shapes, candles in decorative cups or teacups, and pebble or ball candles.
decorative_candles.boundary: Includes shaped and novelty candles, cup/teacup candles and decorative candle sets; excludes tealights (tealight_candles), dinner, taper and pillar candles (dinner_taper_pillar_candles) and scented jar or tin candles (scented_candles).

season_extra._why: unambiguous Christmas words missed by the LLM list (added by B 2026-11-12)

design._why: keep named collections only; generic motifs (heart, rose, star, bird, cat, spotty, floral ...) are dropped because they describe a picture, not a product range

seed_overrides._why: Seed-label fixes found while reviewing taxonomy_v1 (v0 keyword-rule errors). Regex on canonical description; from = current label.
